rule.message:
All freshmen in the College of Science and Engineering must complete CSE 1001 First Year Experience.
At least 31 upper division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus.
All degree-seeking students must complete the University's  Liberal Education requirements .
View  Four-year Plans  for the College of Science and Engineering.
Multiple courses may count for the Senior Laboratory Elective, Technical Elective, or Specialization Elective. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
Students must complete 9 courses before admission to the program. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
Complete any sub-plan requirements that apply to you: Integrated Degree Program B.M.E/M.S.M.E. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
